clips.title: The story
paras: At the Sludge Fen, Samophlange machinery keeps the Venture Company's digging rig running. Three valves must be sealed before the central apparatus can be shut down safely.

At the Sludge Fen, the Venture Company's machinery is complex and dangerous. The central console makes clear that the core cannot be stopped with a single switch. Its feed lines must be handled by hand first, or the apparatus could fail or explode.

Three valves control the flow into the rig: the Main Control Valve, the Fuel Control Valve, and the Regulator Valve. Each must be sealed by hand against high pressure. As they close, the console's green indicators fade to yellow, making it safe to engage the central shutoff.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The three control valves are currently opened. The various readings on the control panel lead you to presume that they must be shut off before the apparatus can be shut off.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Blinking lights on the control console indicate that the main control valves have not been closed off.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The lights indicating the three control valves dim as they are shut off. Green lights slowly fade into yellow, and the switch controlling the apparatus is now moveable, with the valves closed, it can be turned off.
